description: React hook 'useTheme' for managing theme (light/dark) preference in a React application. Handles persistence via localStorage, applies theme attribute to HTML element, and respects system preference on initial load.

methods.name: useTheme()
methods.description: Custom React hook that provides theme state management (light/dark), including persistence, toggling, and initial system preference detection.

methods.name: getInitial
methods.description: Callback function to determine initial theme based on stored preference or system preference.

methods.name: toggleTheme
methods.description: Callback function to toggle between 'light' and 'dark' themes.
